title: A survey on invariant conformal Killing forms on Lie groups
comment: To appear in Matemática Contemporânea. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2002.01208 by other authors
abstract: In this survey we review recent results on left-invariant conformal Killing p-forms on Lie groups endowed with a left-invariant metric. We also mention interesting open questions that could lead into future research.
